item.title: Sanju Samson, Jasprit Bumrah among four Indians included in ICC’s 'Team of the Tournament' for T20 World Cup 2026
item.description: The 2026 edition of ICC Men’s T20 World Cup concluded on Sunday (March 8), with India clinching the title by beating New Zealand in the final at Ahmedabad. A day later, the ICC announced its 'Team of the Tournament' for the T20 World Cup, featuring as many as four Indian players. Player-of-the-Tournament Sanju Samson leads the list, having amassed 321 runs from just five innings. item.title: WATCH: “Deserved the title,” Shahid Afridi, other former Pakistan players hail India’s T20 World Cup 2026 triumph
item.description: India outclassed New Zealand by 96 runs in the final of the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026 at Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad on Sunday (March 8). As a result, the Men in Blue became the first team to defend their T20 World Cup title, win the trophy on three occasions and win on home soil. item.title: “You pick players based on trust…,” Gautam Gambhir explains why India continued backing Abhishek Sharma during T20 World Cup
item.description: India opener Abhishek Sharma silenced his critics with a blistering half-century in the T20 World Cup 2026 final against New Zealand at Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad on Sunday (March 8). The southpaw, who had managed only 89 runs from seven innings prior to the final, rose to the occasion in the title clash by slamming the fastest half-century of the tournament. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: WATCH- ‘Tera ek mahina form gaya tha, main do saal bahar tha’- Ishan Kishan’s funny banter with Abhishek Sharma
item.description: Abhishek Sharma and Ishan Kishan, India's standout batsmen, shared a humorous moment during the post-match press conference following their 96-run triumph against New Zealand in the T20 World Cup 2026 final. Both players played important roles in the title match: Abhishek hit 52 off 21 balls while Kishan hit 54 off 25 deliveries. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: 'Narendra Modi Stadium being a panauti is done and dusted’- Harbhajan Singh after India’s win in Ahmedabad
item.description: Harbhajan Singh, ex-India spinner, has rubbished the notion that Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad is a panauti (inauspicious) for the Indian team. His words came after India defeated New Zealand in the final of the T20 World Cup 2026 on Sunday, March 8, to become three-time T20 World champions. The argument over the venue heated up following India's defeat to Australia in the 2023 Cricket World Cup final at the same stadium. item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: “Maybe your career is on the line”- Gambhir says Sanju showed huge 'character and courage'
item.description: Team India head coach Gautam Gambhir lavished rich praise on Sanju Samson after his brilliant Player of the Tournament performance in India’s successful T20 World Cup 2026 campaign. India defeated New Zealand in the final in Ahmedabad on March 8 by 96 runs to become champions. Samson, who was benched during the earlier part of the tournament, got to play five games and hammered three half-centuries in must-win matches. item.title: “It's all rubbish,” Gambhir’s blunt reply to team atmosphere-related questions after India's T20 World Cup 2026 triumph
item.description: India head coach Gautam Gambhir on Monday (March 9) rubbished the talks of team atmosphere not being good in the dressing room under his tenure. Gambhir has enjoyed success as India’s white-ball coach, winning the Champions Trophy and Asia Cup last year and defending the T20 World Cup title a couple of days back. item.title: “Identify the players who are suited,” Gautam Gambhir set to start working on blueprint for ODI World Cup 2027 during IPL 2026
item.description: Gautam Gambhir took over as India head coach from Rahul Dravid in July 2024. Since then, he has guided India to two ICC titles - Champions Trophy 2025 and T20 World Cup 2026. Gambhir now has set his eyes on the ODI World Cup, scheduled to be held in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia next year. After becoming the first Indian coach to secure two ICC titles, Gambhir said that he will be working on the blueprint for ODI World Cup 2027 during the IPL months. item.title: BCCI announces whopping cash reward for India’s T20 World Cup winning squad
item.description: The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) on Tuesday (March 10) announced a cash reward worth Rs 131 crore for the India cricket team after they scripted history by winning a record third ICC Men’s T20 World Cup title. item.title: Gujarat Titans appoint Matthew Hayden as batting coach ahead of IPL 2026 season
item.description: Gujarat Titans (GT) on Tuesday (March 10) announced the appointment of legendary Australia opener Matthew Hayden as their batting coach for the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2026 season. This will be Hayden’s first high-profile coaching stint in the IPL, having previously worked as a commentator in the league.
